messages:
noah: that sparkler exit was theatrical. my webcam glittered for 3 whole minutes. :sparkles:
anya: best unintended mic effect: someone sneezed and it sounded like a cymbal crash. instant drum solo. :sneezing_face::drum_with_drumsticks:
carmen: pet parade highlight: ivy's ferret stole the show and a sticky note. ferret = new onboarding buddy. :mouse2:
liam: shoutout to the AV hero who turned the sparkler off before the smoke alarm. we love you. :heart:
ivy: confession: ferret was bribed with donut crumbs. full co-conspirator report incoming. :doughnut:
all-hands-bot: recording + slides uploaded: https://drive.example.com/all-hands/1799998000.mp4 :movie_camera:
noah: quick poll: favorite encore moment? a) sparkler b) sneeze cymbal c) ferret cameo d) surprise confetti pocket
anya: voting sneeze cymbal. it was unexpectedly cinematic.
liam: voting ferret. ferret has stage presence.
carmen: also can we get a follow-up thread for ferret name suggestions? current leader: 'Sticky Note Steve'.
ivy: love it. runner-up: 'Sir Crumbs-a-Lot'.
noah: minor production note: someone left a leftover sparkler in the kitchenette. facilities said not to do that again. safety first.
anya: agreed. also, next time can we have a tiny 'afterparty' voice channel for 5 mins? low-key hangout.
liam: +1 for afterparty. good for remote folks.
all-hands-bot: transcript: https://drive.example.com/all-hands/1799998000.txt
carmen: favorite quote pick: "We ship code and occasionally glitter." framing that for my desk. :frame_with_picture:
noah: final: thank you team. tiny chaos, big morale. logging off with sparkly hands. :raised_hands:
